crossRefs.note: The sea has come up on Babylon. She is covered with the multitude of its waves.
“You shall tell them, ‘Yahweh of Armies, the God of Israel says: “Drink, and be drunk, vomit, fall, and rise no more…
But with an overflowing flood, he will make a full end of her place, and will pursue his enemies into darkness.
What do you plot against Yahweh? He will make a full end. Affliction won’t rise up the second time.
Another, a second angel, followed, saying, “Babylon the great has fallen, which has made all the nations to drink of…
He cried with a mighty voice, saying, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon the great, and she has become a habitation of demons…
A mighty angel took up a stone like a great millstone and cast it into the sea, saying, “Thus with violence will…
Yahweh of Armies says: “The wide walls of Babylon will be utterly overthrown. Her high gates will be burned with fire.…
Behold, isn’t it of Yahweh of Armies that the peoples labor for the fire, and the nations weary themselves for vanity?
He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
let briers grow instead of wheat, and stinkweed instead of barley.” The words of Job are ended.
This ends the prayers by David, the son of Jesse.

people.name: Babylon
people.line: Ancient Mesopotamian city, capital of Babylonian Empire, site of the Tower of Babel.

people.name: Jeremiah
people.line: Son of Hilkiah, the prophet during Judah's final days.

translations.web: Then you shall say, ‘Thus will Babylon sink, and will not rise again because of the evil that I will bring on her; and they will be weary.’ ” Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
translations.bsb: Then you are to say, ‘In the same way Babylon will sink and never rise again, because of the disaster I will bring upon her. And her people will grow weary.’” Here end the words of Jeremiah.
translations.kjv: And thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise from the evil that I will bring upon her: and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
translations.asv: and thou shalt say, Thus shall Babylon sink, and shall not rise again because of the evil that I will bring upon her; and they shall be weary. Thus far are the words of Jeremiah.
